title: Dynamic Mixed-Precision Routing for Efficient Multi-step LLM Interaction
abstract: arXiv:2602.02711v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) achieve strong performance in long-horizon agentic tasks through multi-step interaction and reasoning at test time. However, repeatedly invoking these models incurs substantial inference cost over an episode. Post-training quantization (PTQ) reduces this cost, but using a fixed low precision throughout an episode can sharply lower task success. We observe that interaction steps differ sharply in their sensitivity to quantization: given the same context, decoding a step at low precision turns a success into a failure at only about 1% of the steps, which we call critical steps. translated_title: 面向高效多步大语言模型交互的动态混合精度路由
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）通过测试时的多步交互与推理，在长时程智能体任务中取得了出色表现。然而，反复调用这些模型会在整个任务过程中产生高昂的推理成本。训练后量化（PTQ）可以降低这一成本，但在整个过程中始终使用固定的低精度会显著降低任务成功率。我们观察到，不同交互步骤对量化的敏感程度差异极大：在相同上下文条件下，仅有约1%的步骤在低精度解码时会将成功变为失败，我们将这些步骤称为“关键步骤”。基于这一观察，我们提出了动态混合精度路由（DMR），这是一个能够在每个决策步骤中自适应地在同一大语言模型的高精度版本与低精度版本之间进行选择的框架。DMR利用全空间分解来联合预测某一步骤的偏差及其对最终结果的影响，从而学会识别关键步骤（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出动态混合精度路由（DMR）框架，通过识别仅约1%的对量化敏感的“关键步骤”，在每个决策步骤自适应地在大语言模型的高精度与低精度版本之间切换，从而在大幅降低推理成本的同时保持任务成功率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Dynamic Mixed-Precision Routing (DMR), a framework that adaptively switches between high-precision and low-precision versions of the same LLM at each decision step by identifying the rare (~1%) quantization-sensitive "critical steps," thereby substantially reducing inference cost while preserving task success.
